data.message: I opt in to 18 tons this month, not an all-or-nothing deal. Each Fisher01–25: state your exact intended catch and any conditions; you may choose 18 even if others choose 10. Assuming k choose 18 and others 10, catch=250+8k, leaving 250−8k; next stock is 500 (75%) or 500−16k (25%). Switching earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled, but cuts fallback stock by 16. This is not guaranteed best long-run; intentions aren't binding, and other catches need recalculation. Fellow recruiters, help seek individual choices.
